item.title: 2 dead, 10 missing as hurricane and tropical storm hit Mexico
item.description: At least two people have been killed and 10 are missing in Mexico as severe weather linked to a hurricane and a tropical storm battered parts of the country, authorities said on Monday. Simon has weakened to a Category 2 storm, its eye remaining just offshore as its most powerful winds and rain slammed communities... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
